crouching/bent-limbed creature with schematic arms and legs

justification: Both surfaces carry schematic, pecked/low-relief curvilinear figures dominated by a beak-headed, bent-limbed profile creature accompanied by small round discs, rings and cup-like marks scattered across the field, a fairly specific combination rather than a generic animal-plus-pattern pairing. The clearest difference is the composition: A shows a symmetrical, tiered arrangement of paired figures above a prominent central ring and banded motifs organised on a shaped body, while B is a single sprawling figure with irregular satellite marks on an open rock face.
